subject: Error when starting the shiny app

messages.author: cbeede9b330a5da8
messages.subject: Error when starting the shiny app
parts:
Hi buddies,

My apps url is this : https://xuwenhao.shinyapps.io/shiny-toy/
The source code of the app is here : https://xuwenhao.shinyapps.io/shiny-toy/

It is an assignment of the coursera data science course.

I could start the shiny apps on my local machine successfully. And I could also deploy the apps successfully.
But when I wanted to show it on shinyapps.io, it told me the following message, is there anything I could do to fix it? I have used the caret package to show a super small decision tree online.

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Loading required package: lattice Loading required package: ggplot2 Warning in fun(libname, pkgname) : no DISPLAY variable so Tk is not available Error in checkInstall(models$library) : Calls: runApp ... train.formula -> train -> train.default -> checkInstall Execution halted

messages.author: cbeede9b330a5da8
messages.subject: Re: Error when starting the shiny app
parts:
Hi buddies, 

 I finally found the reason. I have to explicitly load the rpart library in the code uploaded to shiny since the caret package I am using will use the rpart package to train a decision tree model.

The caret package will load related packages implicitly on my local machine, but you have to explicitly load them in your code, then shiny apps would install these packages for your app on the cloud.
